soldier: Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.63–0.65, lateral margins nearly parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised, their tops broad and rounded, the space between them rather flat with several shallow longitudinal striae. Labrum lanceolate, narrow and rounded at the apex, with two apical setae; subapical setae short, lateral apical setae absent. Mandibles slender and slightly curved at the apex, 0.59–0.62 times head capsule length but shorter than the head width. Antennae 14–15 segments. Postmentum 7–9 times as long as the waist constriction, waist constriction index 0.34–0.36, ratio of waist width to head width about 1:6 to 1:7. Pronotum about 1.4–1.6 times as wide as long, anterior margin formed by the intersection of two arcs, lateral margins narrowly rounded and extending posteriorly, posterior margin shallowly incised in the middle; more than 30 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
